spec.name: persona-commands
spec.intent: RULINGS: (1) No new `cratylus uninstall` verb in this unit; a verb named uninstall must remove everything install placed, which belongs to the consumer-surface piece. Build the placement module's remove() and prove it in tests; the verb calls it later. (2) One command per persona name across harnesses: whichever harness's install is asked to link owns ~/.local/bin/<persona>; the other harness's link is never replaced, and the clash is reported naming both. No suffixed names. ASSAY FOLLOW-UP (6e6986b5): (1) ADOPT: a link at ~/.local/bin/<persona> that resolves exactly to THIS harness's launcher but was not recorded (made by hand, e.g. from the interim recipe) is adopted: recorded in personaLinks and reported 'adopted', never re-created; a link to anything else stays blocked. (2) SIGN: rename the flag --link-personas to --link-persona-commands (what it links is persona commands), everywhere: CLI, help, prompt text, docs, changeset, tests. Removal stays the routine; the uninstall verb is the separate concept 'uninstall' (consumer surface).
